result.summary: SSA-001 shows repeated out-of-service events with fixes that did not hold, including intake filter packing and filter-only swaps.

findings.claim: SSA-001 had an OOS event on 2026-09-02 with ACT-17 where the fix did not hold because the intake filter was packed with dust.
SSA-001 had an OOS event on 2026-09-16 with ACT-11 where the fix did not hold for the same intake filter issue.
SSA-001 had a MICROFIX on 2026-10-14 with ACT-11 where the fix did not hold because only a filter swap was performed.
SSA-001 is an RTU-12 unit located at North roof-n1.

result.headline: SSA-001 shows repeated out-of-service events with fixes that did not hold, including intake filter packing and filter-only swaps.
result.recommended_next_check: Inspect the root cause of recurring intake filter packing on SSA-001 and evaluate whether the unit itself is at fault.
